provenance.tool: WayriCAD Quick PI / 2.5D DC conductivity FEM
assumptions: Executed WayriCAD Quick PI 2.5D DC conductor solve on the exact source geometry; nominal3.3V rail with an explicit normalized1A controller load, not measured device performance.
Generic source A is one saved regulator output contact; load B is one saved controller supply contact. Both are ideal equipotential electrodes; other contacts have no external load.
Both saved35micrometre copper layers are solved together at20C; plated barrel thickness is assumed25micrometres.

Each displayed square is inscribed strictly inside one actual FEM copper triangle. Its voltage drop is barycentrically interpolated at the triangle incenter; no arbitrary or extrapolated gradient is used.
Sample squares cover only part of each triangle; gaps are unsampled. Display cells are not a replacement for the full triangular solution or exact field integration.
The fixed0..39.976681141mV scale and summary maxima come from the full numerical solution, not display-cell maxima.
Original board XY coordinates are retained for alignment with the review derivative. Source and review geometry must be independently checked before rebinding the exact source hash.
No semiconductor/package/contact resistance, loaded return path, regulator dynamics, AC impedance, thermal field or measurement validation is included.
Total-drop refinement changes are0.1507625% and0.4720378%; current and power conservation checks passed. Local current-density peaks are not qualified.
This display-only field contains scalar sample patches, not PCB source, schematic, netlist, BOM, full solution arrays or component/model identities.
A small local FEM undershoot is retained in the data (minimum display patch approximately-0.000149mV). The fixed nonnegative color scale clamps its displayed color only, not its numeric value.
